link.note: Witness in 1815 and 1836 Munzingen entries; relationship speculative.

summary: Probable relative (uncle or grandfather) of Agatha Heizler; former glazier.
bio: Witness to Veronica Heitzler's 1815 burial and to the 1836 Birkenmayer–Heizler marriage ('formerly glazier, now farmer'). Possibly where Servatius learned glazing (speculative).
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-119 ; http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-464
